rule.message:
All degree-seeking students must complete the University’s Liberal Education requirements.
At least 16 upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Transfer students can find more information here:
https://cbs.umn.edu/future-students/transferring-cbs Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Integrated BS/MPH-Environmental Health. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
